title: AVIBE model card
description: WI-G1: public transparency record for one servable weight set. Mirrors generation_models plus the G-MODEL evidence bundle (AVIBE_자체생성AI_준비계획서 §8). Served at /models/:slug after launch.

weightsHash.description: SHA-256 of the exact servable weight files.

license.description: Weight license basis, e.g. Apache-2.0 (re-verified per release).

intendedUse.description: What the model is for (consumer words, no jargon on the page).

trainingDataCategories.description: Allowed-source categories only (preparation doc §3.2). Banned sources (§3.1) must never appear.

eval.description: G-MODEL automatic + human evaluation summary (detail in generator/eval outputs).

audioDistance.description: FAD-family audio quality distance (lower is better).

redteam.description: Safety red-team result summary (artist mimicry, hateful lyrics, ...).

watermarkRobustness.description: Survived transforms, e.g. mp3-128k, resample-44.1k, re-record.

legalClearedAt.description: G-MODEL item 8: counsel sign-off timestamp (null until cleared).
